Shows coast of Colombia in vicinity of Santa Marta. In cartouche of Real Escuela de Navegación, Departamento de Cádiz: 1756. Depths shown by soundings. Prime meridian: Tenerife. Oriented with north to the bottom. Watermarks: IV; and, fleur-de-lis. Pen-and-ink and watercolor. Mounted on cloth backing. Maggs number annotated in pencil in lower right margin: 299.
